mainTopic: Is a טומטום just a doubt or its own category? The גמרא answers many ברייתות by removing 'טומטום', then suggests the question is argued by תנאים.
overview: The גמרא is working with the view that a טומטום is really either male or female; we just cannot tell which. Only an אנדרוגינוס is treated as its own category that needs a פסוק to exclude it. The גמרא brings ברייתות on ערכין, שלמים and עולה that use a פסוק to exclude both a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס. Each time it answers סמי מיכן טומטום: take the word טומטום out of the ברייתא. It does the same with a ברייתא about bird offerings, where רבי אליעזר says male and female do not matter for birds. It does the same again with רבי אלעזר's list of animals that cannot take part in תמורה, as explained by שמואל. When one version of that list counts 'five', the גמרא swaps טומטום for a יתום to keep the number right. Finally, the גמרא asks whether the question is argued by תנאים. In the ברייתא of רבי אילעאי, the חכמים and רבי שמעון בן יהודה, removing טומטום would make two opinions the same. So they must argue about a טומטום: the חכמים treat it as a ספק that is holy out of doubt, and רבי שמעון disagrees. The explanation continues on the next amud.

steps.title: A ברייתא on ערכין excludes a טומטום from the word 'the male'
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the view that a טומטום is only a case of doubt, because a ברייתא uses the פסוק 'הזכר' to exclude both a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: But why is it taught in a ברייתא: 'The male', and not a טומטום or an אנדרוגינוס?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a ברייתא about ערכין, the fixed amounts given when someone pledges a person's 'value' to the מקדש. The ברייתא uses the word 'the male' to exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס, and the גמרא uses this to attack the view it is working with.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If a טומטום is really a male or a female and we just don't know which, no פסוק should be needed to exclude it. Yet the ברייתא spends a פסוק on it. That suggests a טומטום is treated as its own separate category, like an אנדרוגינוס.

keyTerms.meaning: Why, then? (introduces a challenge)
It was taught in a ברייתא
A person or animal whose private parts are covered, so we cannot tell if it is male or female
A person or animal with both male and female features
A fixed 'value' payment pledged to the מקדש based on age and gender

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the two: a טומטום has hidden features, so we just don't know what it is. An אנדרוגינוס has both sets of features, so it may be a category of its own.

phrases.english: Why, then, is it taught in a baraita:
"The male": but not a tumtum or a hermaphrodite!
phrases.notes: ויקרא 27:3, the פסוק about the valuation of a male.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the view, from the previous part of the daf, that a טומטום is only a case of doubt.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is only a doubt and not a separate category.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A פסוק is used only to exclude a separate category. Since the ברייתא uses a פסוק to exclude a טומטום, it seems to treat a טומטום as a separate category.

steps.title: Take 'טומטום' out of the ברייתא
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the word טומטום should be removed from the ברייתא; the פסוק only excludes an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers by correcting the wording of the ברייתא. It removes the word טומטום, so the ברייתא is only talking about an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once טומטום is removed, there is no problem. An אנדרוגינוס is its own category, so it makes sense that a פסוק is needed to exclude it. The טומטום, being only a doubt, never needed a פסוק at all.

keyTerms.meaning: Remove from here; take this word out of the text

steps.whyThisMatters: This same short answer will be repeated again and again in the coming steps, so it is the key to the whole section.

phrases.english: Remove "tumtum" from here.
phrases.notes: The גמרא is saying to fix the wording of the ברייתא so it mentions only the אנדרוגינוס.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge of step 1 by changing the wording of the ברייתא.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Correcting the wording of the source
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא seemed to treat a טומטום as a separate category that needs a פסוק.
steps.terutzMaskana: The ברייתא really only excludes an אנדרוגינוס; the word טומטום does not belong there.

steps.title: The rest of the ערכין ברייתא: not even a woman's valuation
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings the continuation of the ברייתא, which says a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס get neither a man's nor a woman's valuation, based on 'הזכר' and 'אם נקבה'.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: One might think they do not get a man's valuation but do get a woman's valuation. So the פסוק says 'the male' and 'if a female': but not a טומטום or an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a second challenge from the next part of the same ברייתא. This part again uses פסוקים to exclude a טומטום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא first considers that maybe they at least get the lower valuation of a woman. It then uses both words, 'male' and 'female,' to show that only someone who is clearly one or the other gets a valuation. Again a פסוק is being used to exclude a טומטום, which seems to treat it as a separate category.

keyTerms.meaning: Come and hear (introduces a source that may support or challenge a view)
One might have thought
The פסוק teaches us
Female

phrases.english: Come and hear:
One might have thought they would not be valued at the valuation of a man,
but would be valued at the valuation of a woman?
The verse states: "The male... if a female,"
but not a tumtum or a hermaphrodite!

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: יָכוֹל לֹא יְהֵא בְּעֵרֶךְ אִישׁ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new challenge, from the continuation of the same ברייתא.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is only a doubt.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The ברייתא again uses פסוקים to exclude a טומטום from both valuations, which treats it like a separate category.

steps.title: Same answer: remove 'טומטום'
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא again removes the word טומטום from the ברייתא.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the same answer as before: the word טומטום is taken out, and the ברייתא excludes only an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because this is the same ברייתא, the same fix works here too. Only the אנדרוגינוס is being excluded from both a man's and a woman's valuation.

phrases.english: Remove "tumtum" from here.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 3 the same way step 2 answered step 1.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Correcting the wording of the source
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא seemed to exclude a טומטום from valuation with a פסוק.
steps.terutzMaskana: Only the אנדרוגינוס is excluded with a פסוק.

steps.title: A ברייתא on the שלמים: only a definite male or female
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא reads 'אם זכר אם נקבה' by the שלמים as meaning a definite male or a definite female, excluding a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: 'Whether male or female': a definite male or a definite female, but not a טומטום or an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a third challenge, now from a ברייתא about the שלמים offering. The ברייתא learns from the פסוק that only an animal that is clearly male or clearly female may be brought.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Here too the ברייתא uses a פסוק to exclude a טומטום. That again seems to treat it as a separate category and not just a doubt.

keyTerms.meaning: Definite, certain
Peace offering, which may be male or female

phrases.english: Come and hear: "Whether male or female":
a definite male, a definite female,
but not a tumtum or a hermaphrodite.

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: אִם זָכָר אִם נְקֵבָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new challenge from a different ברייתא, about קרבנות.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is only a doubt.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Using a פסוק to require a 'definite' gender and exclude a טומטום suggests that a טומטום is its own category.

steps.title: Again: remove 'טומטום'
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the word טומטום should be removed from the שלמים ברייתא as well.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the third challenge exactly as before, by taking the word טומטום out of the ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The גמרא is consistent: whenever a ברייתא uses a פסוק to exclude a טומטום, it reads the ברייתא as really excluding only an אנדרוגינוס.

phrases.english: Remove "tumtum" from here.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 5 with the same correction.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Correcting the wording of the source
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא seemed to need a פסוק to exclude a טומטום from the שלמים.
steps.terutzMaskana: The פסוק excludes only an אנדרוגינוס.

steps.title: An extra 'זכר' by the עולה excludes a טומטום
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא learns that the second 'זכר' by the עולה is extra, so it comes to exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: 'The male', and not a female. When it says 'male' below, there was no need to say it. Why does it say it? To exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a fourth challenge from a ברייתא about the עולה. The first 'male' already excludes a female, so the second 'male' must be teaching something new: to exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This challenge is stronger, because a whole extra word in the תורה is being used to exclude a טומטום. That seems to show clearly that a טומטום is treated as its own category that needs a special exclusion.

keyTerms.meaning: Below, later in the same passage
There was no need for the פסוק to say it
To exclude
Burnt offering, which must be a male

phrases.english: Come and hear: "A male": but not a female.
When it says "male" below,
phrases.notes: ויקרא 1:10, an עולה from sheep or goats.

phrases.english: there was no need for the verse to say it;
so why does the verse say it?
To exclude a tumtum and a hermaphrodite.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A fourth challenge, from a ברייתא that uses an extra word in the פסוק.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is only a doubt.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: An extra word is spent on excluding a טומטום. That only makes sense if a טומטום is a separate category.

steps.title: Fourth answer: remove 'טומטום' here too
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא again removes טומטום, so the extra 'זכר' comes only to exclude an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the fourth challenge just like the first three. The word טומטום is removed, and the extra word excludes only an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Even an extra word in the תורה does not force the גמרא to change its view. The extra word is needed for the אנדרוגינוס, which is a separate category. A טומטום is only a doubt and needs no פסוק.
steps.whatToRemember: So far, four challenges seem to use פסוקים to exclude a טומטום, and each time the גמרא answers סמי מיכן טומטום. According to this view, a פסוק is needed only to exclude an אנדרוגינוס, which is its own category. A טומטום is just a doubt, really a male or a female. More challenges follow in the next steps.

phrases.english: Remove "tumtum" from here.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers step 7 with the same correction; the series of challenges continues in step 9.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Correcting the wording of the source
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The extra 'זכר' seemed to exclude a טומטום as its own category.
steps.terutzMaskana: The extra 'זכר' excludes only an אנדרוגינוס; a טומטום is only a doubt.

steps.title: A bird ברייתא treats a טומטום bird as unfit
steps.stepSummary: A ברייתא says a טומטום bird killed by מליקה stays impure like a נבלה, meaning it is unfit for the מזבח. רבי אליעזר's opinion inside the ברייתא shows why this is hard: for birds, male or female does not matter.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: A bird that was worshipped, or set aside for idol worship, or given as a prostitute's payment, or as the price of a dog, and a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס: all of them make garments impure in the throat. רבי אליעזר says: a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס do not make garments impure in the throat. For רבי אליעזר used to say: wherever the תורה says 'male and female,' you exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס from among them. But a bird, since 'male and female' is not said about it, you do not exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס from among them!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings another ברייתא to challenge the idea that a טומטום is just a hidden male or female. The first opinion there treats a טומטום bird as unfit for the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A bird offering killed by מליקה becomes pure only if it was fit for the מזבח. If it was unfit, it counts as a נבלה and makes a person impure when he swallows it. The first opinion says a טומטום bird stays impure, so it must be unfit. But for birds the תורה never requires 'male' or 'female.' A hidden male or female should be perfectly fine, so why is it unfit?

keyTerms.meaning: Killing a bird offering by pinching the back of its neck with a fingernail
A bird that died without a proper killing; it makes a person impure when he swallows it
The throat, the place of swallowing
A payment given to a prostitute; it may not be brought as an offering
The price of a dog; it also may not be brought as an offering
Here: an animal set aside for idol worship

steps.confusionAlert: 'Makes garments impure' is not a strictness against this bird. It shows the bird was unfit, because a fit bird offering killed by מליקה would be pure.

phrases.english: Come and hear:
A bird that was worshipped, and one set aside [for idol worship],
and a prostitute's payment, and the price [of a dog],
and a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס
all of them make garments impure
in the throat.
phrases.notes: A dead bird makes a person impure only when he swallows it, and then the clothes he is wearing become impure too.

phrases.english: רבי אליעזר says:
a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס do not make garments impure
in the throat,
for רבי אליעזר used to say:
wherever 'male and female' is said,
you exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס from among them.

phrases.aramaic: וְעוֹף, הוֹאִיל וְלֹא נֶאֱמַר בּוֹ ״זָכָר וּנְקֵבָה״,
phrases.english: But a bird, since 'male and female' is not said about it,

phrases.aramaic: אֵין אַתָּה מוֹצִיא טוּמְטוּם וְאַנְדְּרוֹגִינוֹס מִבֵּינֵיהֶם!
phrases.english: you do not exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס from among them!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Another challenge in the same series of ברייתות that list טומטום next to אנדרוגינוס.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is really a hidden male or female.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: For birds, male or female does not matter. A hidden male or female should therefore be fit, yet the first opinion treats a טומטום bird as unfit.

steps.title: Remove טומטום from the bird ברייתא
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers as before: take the word טומטום out of this ברייתא.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge the same way it answered the earlier ones. It removes טומטום from the ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once טומטום is removed, the first opinion says only an אנדרוגינוס bird is unfit. That fits the view that an אנדרוגינוס is truly different. A טומטום, which is really a male or a female, is fit as a bird offering.
steps.whatToRemember: Each time a ברייתא lists טומטום with אנדרוגינוס as excluded, the גמרא removes טומטום, so that only the אנדרוגינוס stays excluded.

phrases.english: Remove טומטום from here.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Changing the wording of the ברייתא (removing a word)
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא says a טומטום bird is unfit, so a טומטום must not be a simple hidden male or female.
steps.terutzMaskana: The word טומטום is taken out. Only an אנדרוגינוס bird is unfit.

steps.title: רבי אלעזר lists טומטום among animals that cannot become holy
steps.stepSummary: A new ברייתא: רבי אלעזר says a טריפה, כלאים, יוצא דופן, טומטום and אנדרוגינוס cannot become holy and cannot make another animal holy. This opens the next challenge.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: רבי אלעזר says: a טריפה, a כלאים animal, a יוצא דופן, a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס do not become holy, and they do not make another animal holy.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a new source to challenge its approach once more. Here it is only quoting the source; step 12 finishes the challenge and step 13 answers it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי אלעזר puts the טומטום in a list of animals that do not become holy and do not make another animal holy. He treats it just like the אנדרוגינוס, as if it were a truly different kind of animal. That seems to go against the view that a טומטום is just a hidden male or female.

keyTerms.meaning: An animal with a fatal defect
An animal born from two different species
An animal born through the side, by caesarean section
They do not become holy and do not make another animal holy (no תמורה)

phrases.english: Come and hear: רבי אלעזר says:
a טריפה, and a כלאים animal,
and one born by caesarean section,
a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס
do not become holy and do not make holy.
phrases.notes: 'Do not make holy' means that if one of these is holy and someone tries to swap a regular animal for it, the regular animal does not become holy.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new challenge in the same series, brought right after the bird ברייתא was answered.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is really a hidden male or female.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: רבי אלעזר groups the טומטום with animals that can never become holy, alongside the אנדרוגינוס. That seems to treat it as a truly different kind of animal.

steps.title: שמואל explains the ברייתא, which sharpens the challenge
steps.stepSummary: שמואל explains that the five animals in רבי אלעזר's ברייתא cannot become holy through תמורה and cannot make another animal holy as a תמורה. That is hard for the view that a טומטום is really a male or a female.
steps.simpleTranslation: And שמואל explained: these animals do not become holy through תמורה, and they cannot make another animal holy as a תמורה. So why is a טומטום on the list?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes the challenge it started in step 11. It brings שמואל's explanation of what 'cannot become holy and cannot make holy' means.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to שמואל, the ברייתא is talking about the rules of תמורה. If a טומטום is really a male or a female, it should work for תמורה like any normal animal. So listing it with the disqualified animals goes against the view that a טומטום is only a ספק.

keyTerms.meaning: Substitution: trying to swap a regular animal for a holy one, which makes the new animal holy too
They do not become holy
They make another animal holy

phrases.english: And שמואל said:
They do not become holy through substitution,
and they do not make another animal holy as a substitute!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the challenge from רבי אלעזר's ברייתא by explaining what it means.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that a טומטום is only a ספק male or female, not a separate creature.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: A ספק male or female should be fully able to take part in תמורה, yet the ברייתא lists טומטום among animals that cannot.

steps.title: Remove טומטום from this ברייתא too
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers in its usual way: take טומטום out of the ברייתא.
steps.simpleTranslation: Take the word טומטום out of this ברייתא.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge the same way it answered in steps 8 and 10. It says the word טומטום does not belong in this ברייתא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: With טומטום removed, the ברייתא lists only animals that really are disqualified, such as an אנדרוגינוס. The view that a טומטום is just a ספק stays standing.

phrases.english: Remove טומטום from here.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Changing the wording of the ברייתא
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The ברייתא lists טומטום as unable to become holy through תמורה.
steps.terutzMaskana: The word טומטום is taken out, so the ברייתא is not a challenge.

steps.title: A version of the ברייתא that counts five animals
steps.stepSummary: Another version of רבי אלעזר's ברייתא says 'five', and lists טומטום as one of them. If we remove טומטום, only four are left.
steps.simpleTranslation: Come and hear: רבי אלעזר says, five animals cannot become holy and cannot make another animal holy: a טריפה, כלאים, a יוצא דופן, a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס. And if you say we should remove טומטום here too, there would only be four!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a second version of the same ברייתא. This one gives a number, which blocks the easy answer of removing טומטום.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Once the ברייתא says 'five', taking out one item would break the count. So the answer from step 13 seems not to work here.

keyTerms.meaning: Five
Then there would be only four
And if you would say (the גמרא heads off an expected answer)

phrases.english: Come and hear: רבי אלעזר says:
Five do not become holy and do not make holy,
and these are they: the טריפה, and the כלאים,
and an animal born by caesarean, and a טומטום, and an אנדרוגינוס.
And if you would say, here too
remove טומטום from here,
then there are only four!

steps.triggerLanguage: תָּא שְׁמַע: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר אוֹמֵר: חֲמִשָּׁה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the answer of step 13 using a version of the ברייתא that gives a number.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The ברייתא counts five, so removing טומטום leaves the list one short.

steps.title: Take out טומטום and put in a יתום
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that we remove טומטום and add a יתום, so the count stays at five.
steps.simpleTranslation: Take out טומטום and put in a יתום.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא saves its answer by swapping טומטום for a different disqualified animal, so the list still has five.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A יתום here is an animal born after its mother died, and it is also unfit as a קרבן. By putting it in place of טומטום, the number five works and the view that a טומטום is only a ספק is kept.

keyTerms.meaning: Take out
Bring in, insert
An 'orphan' animal, one born after its mother died

steps.whatToRemember: Every ברייתא that seems to treat טומטום as a separate creature is answered by changing its wording. When there is a number, the גמרא swaps in a יתום to keep the count right.

phrases.english: Take out טומטום, and put in an orphan.
phrases.notes: The 'orphan' is an animal born after its mother died, which is also unfit for the מזבח.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the problem of the count raised in step 14.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Swapping one word for another in the ברייתא
steps.terutzMaskana: Replace טומטום with יתום, so there are still five.

steps.title: Is this a disagreement among תנאים?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא suggests that the question about טומטום is a disagreement among תנאים. It brings a ברייתא with three opinions about an אנדרוגינוס and about the word 'זכר'.
steps.simpleTranslation: Shall we say this is a disagreement among תנאים? רבי אילעאי says in the name of רבי ישמעאל: an אנדרוגינוס is a בכור, and it comes with its blemish. The חכמים say: holiness does not take hold of it. רבי שמעון בן יהודה says in the name of רבי שמעון: the פסוק says 'הזכר', and wherever 'זכר' is said, it comes only to exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא changes direction. Instead of answering another ברייתא, it asks whether the question of טומטום is really an argument between תנאים, and it brings the ברייתא it will study.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי שמעון בן יהודה says 'זכר' excludes a טומטום, which sounds like he treats a טומטום as a separate creature. The גמרא will next try to show that the חכמים disagree with him about exactly this point.

keyTerms.meaning: Shall we say this is a disagreement among תנאים?
A firstborn male animal, holy from birth
Its blemish is with it; it is holy but born blemished
Holiness does not take hold of it

phrases.english: Shall we say it is a disagreement among the תנאים?

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי אִילְעַאי אוֹמֵר מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל:
phrases.english: רבי אילעאי says in the name of רבי ישמעאל:
An אנדרוגינוס is a firstborn, and its blemish is with it,
phrases.notes: He means it is holy as a בכור, but its unusual body counts as a blemish from birth.

phrases.aramaic: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: אֵין קְדוּשָּׁה חָלָה עָלָיו.
phrases.english: and the Sages say: holiness does not take hold of it.

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן:
phrases.english: רבי שמעון בן יהודה says in the name of רבי שמעון:
The verse says, 'the male',
and every place where 'male' is said
it comes only to exclude a טומטום and an אנדרוגינוס.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: After defending the ספק view through many ברייתות, the גמרא asks whether the question is really argued by תנאים.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether the status of a טומטום (ספק or separate creature) is a disagreement between תנאים.

steps.title: Removing טומטום here would make two opinions the same
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא shows that the usual answer fails here. Without טומטום, רבי שמעון בן יהודה would be saying the same thing as the חכמים.
steps.simpleTranslation: And if you would say: take טומטום out of this ברייתא, then רבי שמעון בן יהודה would be the same as the חכמים!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא blocks its own usual answer before anyone can use it. In this ברייתא, removing טומטום does not work.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The חכמים already say an אנדרוגינוס is not holy. If רבי שמעון בן יהודה only excludes an אנדרוגינוס, he adds nothing new, and a ברייתא would not list him as a separate opinion.

keyTerms.meaning: That is the same as the חכמים

phrases.english: And if you would say: remove טומטום from here,

phrases.aramaic: רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן יְהוּדָה הַיְינוּ רַבָּנַן!
phrases.english: then רבי שמעון בן יהודה is the same as the Rabbis!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Rules out the usual answer of removing טומטום, which strengthens the suggestion of step 16.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: The answer 'remove טומטום' as applied to this ברייתא.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: It would leave רבי שמעון בן יהודה with no difference from the חכמים.

steps.title: So they must argue about a טומטום
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא concludes that the argument must be about a טומטום. The חכמים say only an אנדרוגינוס cannot become holy, while a טומטום is a ספק and is holy out of doubt. Then רבי שמעון comes and disagrees.
steps.simpleTranslation: Rather, isn't it that they argue about a טומטום? The first תנא holds that holiness does not take hold of an אנדרוגינוס, but a טומטום is a ספק and is holy out of doubt. And רבי שמעון comes...
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא shows what the two sides really argue about. The text breaks off as it begins to explain רבי שמעון's side.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The חכמים (the first תנא) treat a טומטום as a ספק male, so it is holy just in case. רבי שמעון comes to argue, using 'זכר' to exclude a טומטום as well, which treats it as a separate creature. So whether a טומטום is a ספק seems to be argued by תנאים.

keyTerms.meaning: Rather, isn't it that...?
There is a difference between them
The first תנא, the first opinion in the ברייתא
Holy because of the doubt

steps.confusionAlert: Here the first תנא is the חכמים, not רבי אילעאי. Their words 'holiness does not take hold of it' refer only to the אנדרוגינוס, not to a טומטום.
steps.whyThisMatters: If the status of טומטום is argued by תנאים, the view that a טומטום is only a ספק does not need to remove טומטום from every ברייתא. It can simply follow the חכמים.

phrases.english: Rather, is it not that a טומטום is the difference between them,
for the first תנא holds:
'holiness does not take hold of it' is said about the אנדרוגינוס,
but a טומטום is a doubt
and is holy because of the doubt,
and רבי שמעון comes

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Having ruled out removing טומטום, the גמרא concludes that טומטום is the point of disagreement.
steps.raayaObject: That the status of טומטום (ספק or separate creature) is a disagreement among תנאים.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The ברייתא of רבי אילעאי, the חכמים, and רבי שמעון בן יהודה.
